resources.string: Accessibility can read Facebook UI labels. Optional, separately approved general Auto Skip may issue swipes while Facebook is in use and show Stop / approximate Back controls. No screenshots, account info or post text are saved.
Read-only ad candidate and post boundary probe

Read-only ad diagnostics by default. A separately approved general Auto Skip session can issue repeated swipes with Stop / Back control. It can skip normal posts; a reverse swipe does not guarantee exact restoration.

Accessibility can technically read on-screen content and interact with apps. FeedVeil reads limited Facebook UI labels by default. If you separately arm the trial, it may swipe Facebook automatically; it can make mistakes. The service also reads only app package names on window changes to remove controls after switching apps. It does not save post contents, names, passwords, screenshots, or send data anywhere. You can pause or revoke permission at any time.
Only aggregated counters and your local consent/pause settings are stored. No Facebook content is retained. Not affiliated with Meta.
To test, grant access, open the original Facebook app, scroll manually, return here and tap Refresh. Record your observations manually using the Phase 0 test sheet.
Choose Feed or Reels BEFORE opening Facebook. Each selection starts a fresh counter session. This is YOUR test label, not automatic screen recognition.
General Auto Skip — Feed + Reels (OFF by default)

Experimental use only. Feed and Reels manual-test buttons above are optional and do not control Auto Skip. Enable the general mode separately. No fixed skip limit: it runs while Facebook is in use until STOP or leaving the app; 15-second cooldown. Wrong skips are possible. The overlay has Stop, a deliberately tapped swipe test, and approximate Back; exact history cannot be reconstructed. Do not use for unattended browsing.
General Auto Skip is ACTIVE. Stop it with STOP or leave Facebook. False skips are possible.

FeedVeil may incorrectly skip normal Facebook posts. The general mode uses label patterns to estimate Feed versus Reels; some screens cannot be identified safely and will not be skipped. The floating Stop button stops the trial; SWIPE ONCE performs a manual test even without a detected ad (use only while you see an ad); Back tries one reverse swipe, NOT a guaranteed return to the skipped post. There is no fixed skip limit or session timer. Automatic gestures have a minimum 15-second cooldown. No screenshots, content, account identifiers or post history are stored. This is not an ad blocker or validated classifier.
Only provisional containers, not verified ads. Placement clusters are not unique ads. Experimental Auto Skip is separately armed.
Selected-tab hint scans — Feed: %1$d / Reels: %2$d / Unknown: %3$d
